name: procesio_list_processes
title: List PROCESIO processes
description: List the automation processes in a PROCESIO workspace, newest first. Use this to find the id of a process before running, editing or validating it.

search.description: Only processes whose name matches this text.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_create_process
title: Create a PROCESIO process
description: Create a new automation process from a JSON definition of its steps and connections. Returns the new process id. Pass dry_run to see what would be built without creating anything.

config.description: The process definition, as a JSON object.

dry_run.description: Report what would be created; create nothing.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_edit_process
title: Edit a PROCESIO process
description: Change an existing process - add, retarget or reconfigure its steps. Pass dry_run first to see the diff. Removing steps additionally requires allow_remove, so a partial definition cannot silently delete work.

config.description: The changes, as a JSON object.

allow_remove.description: Permit this edit to delete steps.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_validate_process
title: Validate a PROCESIO process
description: Check a process for errors without running it - unconnected steps, missing required inputs, broken references. Do this before running a process you just built. Validating is not the same as running: a process can validate and still fail at execution.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_run_process
title: Run a PROCESIO process
description: Execute a process and return its run id. A process does real work - it can send mail, write to databases and call external systems - so this is never run unattended. Follow it with procesio_get_run_status and procesio_get_run_output.

payload.description: Input values for the run, as a JSON object.

synchronous.description: Wait for the run to finish instead of returning immediately.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_get_run_status
title: Check a PROCESIO run
description: Report whether a run is still going, finished or failed, and which step it reached. Takes the run id returned by procesio_run_process.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_get_run_output
title: Read a PROCESIO run output
description: Return the values a finished run produced. Only meaningful once the run has completed - check with procesio_get_run_status first.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_tidy_process_layout
title: Tidy a process canvas
description: Re-arrange a process's steps on the design canvas so it is readable. Changes only the visual layout, never what the process does. Worth running after building a process through the API, which places steps without arranging them.

dry_run.description: Report the new layout; change nothing.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_list_forms
title: List PROCESIO forms
description: List the forms in a workspace. A form is the screen a person fills in to start or feed a process.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_get_form
title: Read a PROCESIO form
description: Return a form's definition - its fields, their types and how they are laid out.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_create_form
title: Create a PROCESIO form
description: Create a form from a JSON definition. Returns the new form id. Add fields afterwards with procesio_add_form_field.

config.description: The form definition, as a JSON object.

dry_run.description: Report what would be created; create nothing.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_add_form_field
title: Add fields to a PROCESIO form
description: Add one or more input fields to an existing form.

elements.description: The fields to add, as a JSON array.

parent.description: Id of the container to add them into.

dry_run.description: Report what would be added; add nothing.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

annotations.title: Add fields to a PROCESIO form

name: procesio_build_connector
title: Build a PROCESIO connector from API docs
description: Start building a custom PROCESIO connector from an API's documentation. Give it the docs URL and what you need the connector to do; it reads the docs, asks what it still needs, and generates a connector package. Returns a build id - follow it with procesio_get_connector_build.

api_url.description: URL of the API documentation to read.

api_docs_text.description: The documentation itself, if there is no public URL.

user_requirements.description: What the connector needs to do, in plain language.

annotations.title: Build a PROCESIO connector from API docs

name: procesio_list_connector_builds
title: List connector builds
description: List connector builds and their current stage.

name: procesio_get_connector_build
title: Check a connector build
description: Report a build's stage, what it is waiting on, and whether a connector package is ready to download.

name: procesio_download_connector
title: Download a built connector
description: Save a finished build's connector package to a local file, ready to install with procesio_install_connector.

out.description: Local path to write the package to.

name: procesio_install_connector
title: Install a connector into PROCESIO
description: Install a connector package into a workspace, after which its operations appear as steps you can use when building a process.

name.description: Name to show in the designer.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_list_connectors
title: List installed connectors
description: List the connectors installed in a workspace - the extra step types available when building a process.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_list_workspaces
title: List PROCESIO workspaces
description: List the workspaces this account can reach. A workspace holds its own processes, forms, connectors and credentials.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.

name: procesio_list_environments
title: List PROCESIO environments
description: List the configured environments, so a call can be pointed at the right one.

name: procesio_test_credential
title: Test a PROCESIO credential
description: Check that a stored credential can still reach the system it belongs to. Answers whether a connection is working without running a whole process.

config.description: The credential to test, as a JSON object.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in. Omit to use the default workspace.

environment.description: Named environment, e.g. Internal-QA. Omit for the default.
